spec.description: cmon (ClusterControl controller) health per CCX environment: controllers, the datastores they manage, alarms and backups, the cmon pod's containers, and the cmon-exporter sidecar.
cmon controllers reporting up (cmon_up = 1) in the selected environments.
spec.title: Controllers up

spec.description: How many datastores cmon reports in each state, summed over the selected controllers. These cmon *_total metrics are current counts, not counters.
spec.title: Datastores by cmon state

spec.expr: bottomk_avg(15, (max by (ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"})) * on (ClusterName) group_left (DatastoreName) group by (ClusterName, DatastoreName) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}) or on (ClusterName) label_replace(max by (ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}), "DatastoreName", "$1", "ClusterName", "(.*)"))

spec.description: Up/down per datastore over time. Shows the 15 datastores with the most downtime in the selected range, by name (UUID when the datastore has no exporter targets).
spec.title: Datastore up/down history

spec.description: Datastores the selected cmon controllers manage (cmon_cluster_total). This is a current count, not a counter.
spec.title: Datastores managed

spec.description: Critical alarms currently open in cmon across the selected controllers.
spec.title: Critical alarms

spec.description: Open backup-failed alarms in cmon across the selected controllers.
spec.title: Backup-failed alarms

spec.description: Coredumps cmon has detected on managed datastore nodes. Current count reported by cmon.
spec.title: Coredumps

spec.description: Datastores whose last backup failed to upload to object storage.
spec.title: Backup upload failures

spec.description: Open critical and backup-failed alarms and detected coredumps per environment, as reported by cmon.
spec.title: Alarms over time

spec.expr: topk_max(10, (max by (ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_backup_failed{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"})) * on (ClusterName) group_left (DatastoreName) group by (ClusterName, DatastoreName) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}) or on (ClusterName) label_replace(max by (ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_backup_failed{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}), "DatastoreName", "$1", "ClusterName", "(.*)"))

topk_max(10, (max by (ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_backup_upload_failed{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"})) * on (ClusterName) group_left (DatastoreName) group by (ClusterName, DatastoreName) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}) or on (ClusterName) label_replace(max by (ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_backup_upload_failed{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}), "DatastoreName", "$1", "ClusterName", "(.*)"))

spec.description: Datastores whose last backup or backup upload failed (1 = failed). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected range.
spec.title: Backup failures per datastore

spec.description: Datastores cmon currently reports as started. Despite the _total suffix this is a current count that goes up and down.
spec.title: Started

spec.description: CPU used by the cmon-exporter sidecar process (1 = one core). For the cmon controller itself see the container panels.
spec.title: CPU Usage (rate)

spec.description: Resident and virtual memory of the cmon-exporter sidecar process.
spec.title: Memory — RSS & Virtual

spec.description: Network traffic of the cmon pod, read by the cmon-exporter from /proc/net/dev. All containers in the pod share one network namespace, so this is the whole pod (cmon, cmon-ssh and exporter), not just the exporter process.
spec.title: Network I/O (rate)

spec.description: Open file descriptors of the cmon-exporter process and its limit.
spec.title: Open File Descriptors

spec.description: Datastores cmon currently reports as degraded (running with reduced redundancy, e.g. a node down). Current count, not a counter.
spec.title: Degraded

spec.description: Goroutines in the cmon-exporter process. Steady growth points to a leak.
spec.title: Goroutines

spec.description: Go heap usage of the cmon-exporter process.
spec.title: Go Heap Memory

spec.description: Time per second spent in garbage-collection pauses in the cmon-exporter process.
spec.title: GC Pause Duration

spec.description: Requests to the exporter's /metrics endpoint by HTTP code. Non-200 codes mean scrapes are failing.
spec.title: Scrape Requests (metrics endpoint)

spec.description: Datastores cmon currently reports as failed. Current count, not a counter.
spec.title: Failed

spec.description: Datastores cmon currently reports as stopped. Current count, not a counter.
spec.title: Stopped
Controllers down
spec.description: cmon controllers reporting down (cmon_up = 0). The exporter is up but cannot reach cmon.

spec.title: Datastores down
spec.description: Datastores cmon reports as not up right now (cmon_cluster_up = 0).

spec.title: Controllers
spec.description: One row per cmon controller: status, cmon version, datastores managed and how many are down, and open critical alarms.

spec.expr: count by (kubernetes_namespace) (max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}) == 0) or (count by (kubernetes_namespace) (max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"})) * 0)

spec.title: Datastores not healthy now
spec.description: Datastores that cmon currently reports as down, degraded or failed. Empty means every datastore is healthy.

spec.expr: (max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}) == 0) * on (ClusterName) group_left (DatastoreName) group by (ClusterName, DatastoreName) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}) or on (ClusterName) label_replace(max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}) == 0, "DatastoreName", "$1", "ClusterName", "(.*)")

(max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_degraded{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}) > 0) * on (ClusterName) group_left (DatastoreName) group by (ClusterName, DatastoreName) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}) or on (ClusterName) label_replace(max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_degraded{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}) > 0, "DatastoreName", "$1", "ClusterName", "(.*)")

(max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_failure{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}) > 0) * on (ClusterName) group_left (DatastoreName) group by (ClusterName, DatastoreName) (up{job=~"cmon-sd.*"}) or on (ClusterName) label_replace(max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_failure{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}) > 0, "DatastoreName", "$1", "ClusterName", "(.*)")

spec.title: cmon container CPU
spec.description: CPU cores used by the cmon pod's containers: cmon (the controller), cmon-ssh and cmon-exporter. Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected range.

spec.expr: topk_max(10, sum by (namespace, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$environment", pod=~"cmon-.*", container=~"cmon|cmon-ssh|cmon-exporter", job=~".*cadvisor.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: cmon container memory
spec.description: Working-set memory of the cmon pod's containers, with the memory request for comparison. cmon has no memory limit, so the request is the planning reference.

spec.expr: topk_max(10, sum by (namespace, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$environment", pod=~"cmon-.*", container=~"cmon|cmon-ssh|cmon-exporter", job=~".*cadvisor.*"}))
topk_max(10, sum by (namespace, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$environment", pod=~"cmon-.*", resource="memory", container=~"cmon|cmon-ssh|cmon-exporter"}))

spec.title: cmon container restarts
spec.description: Container restarts in the cmon pod per interval. Any restart of the cmon container interrupts datastore management for that environment.

spec.title: Last termination reason
spec.description: Why each cmon container last terminated (for example OOMKilled or Error). Empty means no container has terminated since its pod started.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"$environment", pod=~"cmon-.*"}) > 0

spec.title: Exporter scrape duration
spec.description: How long VictoriaMetrics takes to scrape the cmon exporter (:9954). The exporter queries cmon on each scrape, so slow scrapes usually mean a slow cmon.

spec.title: CMON — ClusterControl Health
